game.title: Breach.
game.subtitle: A hacker card duel. Take down the rival system's integrity before it takes down yours. Play the machine or invite someone with a room code.
game.onlineNote: Online mode connects both browsers directly (WebRTC). A public PeerJS server only helps find the room. Share the code or the link with whoever will play.
rules: Each system starts with 18 integrity. Bring the rival to zero to win.
Every turn you gain CPU (up to 6) and draw a card. Each card costs CPU.
Red attacks remove integrity; firewall absorbs damage first.
Purple defenses raise firewall, restore integrity or arm a honeypot.
The second player starts with one extra card and 1 extra CPU.

bruteforce.name: Brute force
bruteforce.text: Deals 4 damage. +2 if the target has no firewall.

ddos.name: DDoS
ddos.text: Deals 4 damage. Target loses 1 CPU next turn.

ransomware.name: Ransomware
ransomware.text: Deals 6 damage and the target discards 1 card.

honeypot.name: Honeypot
honeypot.text: Cancels the next attack you receive.
